gen-gf-pixelify-sans-outfit: Pixelify Sans draws its blocky letters with one unvarying line and a c that gapes wide open. Outfit softens things with curves that stop short of closing.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans reads modern and precise, with curve endings held apart. Pixelify Sans is the loud one up top, bold and expressive, while the body keeps its monoline lines tidy and quiet.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-sora: Pixelify Sans sets the tone with a bold, expressive look, its strokes all one steady weight. And Sora follows in a precise, geometric voice, its c and s kept widely parted.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-space-grotesk: Chunky, playful, and a little retro, Pixelify Sans holds one steady line weight throughout. And Space Grotesk, a plain sans with breathing counters, gives that energy a level-headed partner underneath.
gen-gf-oxanium-fs-familjen-grotesk: Oxanium looks like fine rope laid into letters, with a high x-height and curves ending in daylight. Familjen Grotesk follows with tall lowercase and bowls left open on one side, so give it a modest size.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-supreme: Snowburst One is a stencil with wide bridges between its tall letters. Supreme reads crisp and neutral underneath, its sturdy strokes keeping every letter held open, so paragraphs move along without tiring.
gen-gf-tektur-fs-epilogue: Epilogue reads approachable and contemporary, with curvy letters and a wire-like skeleton. Its tall lowercase and stubby ascender tips keep a long passage moving easily beneath Tektur's expressive, pipe-cleaner headings.
gen-gf-unica-one-manrope: Commanding is Unica One's mood, with a huge lowercase eye and every stroke at one thickness. Manrope steps in with bright openings at each curve and a minimal step from capitals to lowercase.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-amulya: Shantell Sans has a mouth as wide as a cut tin can lid, drawn with one fixed nib width. Amulya stays contemporary and generous.
